liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Standing on the Moon** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls this the best version of Standing on the Moon they have ever heard; Reviewer identifies this as the best version of Standing on the Moon they ever caught [15][17]
- **Rain** (1 review): The band started the song Rain immediately after a loud thunder crackle and lightning [10]

## The recordings

- **gd1995-06-30.fob.schoeps.evans.GEMS.83144.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 18 songs; 154 min; rated 3.86/5 by 7 [1]
- **gd95-06-30.schoeps.3376.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 17 songs; 148 min; rated 4.04/5 by 71 [2]. Said about its sound: Recording has significant stadium echo, though the reviewer personally enjoys that specific sonic quality; The recording quality is described as not special, focusing solely on audio rather than live experience [9][12]
- **gd1995-06-30.schoeps.clemens.89393.flac1648**: source not stated; 17 songs; 149 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [3]
- **gd1995-06-30.schoeps.jones.wklitz.95189.flac16**: source not stated; 17 songs; 153 min; rated 4/5 by 3 [4]

## Around the show

- Intense lightning and thunder occurred just before the band began playing the song Rain [10]
- Reviewer attended from row 11 on Jerry's side, describing the night as magical [11]
- Friend named Steve commented that the epic Standing on the Moon performance was pathetically Grateful Dead [13]
- Rain and thunder started during the break, and the band took ten to fifteen minutes tuning up [14]
- The performance occurred less than two weeks before the end of the band's music [19]
- Considered a better summer performance, though not as strong as earlier 1995 shows [9]
- Contrasts this show with typical 1995 performances, noting Jerry was usually sick and uninspired elsewhere [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1995-06-30.fob.schoeps.evans.GEMS.83144.flac16**: taped by Todd Evans and Adam Gross; transferred by GEMS; source: Schoeps Mk4 (cardiod) > Schoeps KC5 active Cable > Schoeps CMC 6 mic body > Monster M1000 Jumper cable > Apogee AD1000 A / D Converter (UV16 enabled to use the… [1]
- **gd95-06-30.schoeps.3376.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Ryan Burns; source: Audience: Schoeps MK4's [2]. Also: Recorded with Schoeps CMC6/MK4s to DAT, transferred by Ryan Burns using Sony and Tascam gear [2]
- **gd1995-06-30.schoeps.clemens.89393.flac1648**: taped by Jake Clemens; transferred by Jake Clemens; source: Schoeps mk4->DAT @ 48 kHz (FOB) [3]
- **gd1995-06-30.schoeps.jones.wklitz.95189.flac16**: taped by Roger Jones; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Schoeps MK4's>Reutelhuber Preamp>Casio DAR-100 [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1995-06-30 Fri Three Rivers Stadium, Pittsburgh, PA](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1277269331846/grateful-dead-1995-06-30-fri-three) [22]
- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1995-06-30 Three Rivers Stadium, Pittsburgh, PA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1995-06-30-three-rivers-stadium-pittsburgh-pa-usa/) [23]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Three Rivers Stadium - June 30, 1995](https://www.dead.net/show/june-30-1995) [24]
